hypothesis_summary: By centralizing the redundant MCP client instantiation blocks across multiple event listeners into a single `ensureMcpClient()` helper function in `app/public/app.js`, and centralizing the repetitive `registerTool` catch block error handlers into a `createErrorResponse(violation)` helper function in `app/server.js`, we will significantly reduce cognitive complexity and enforce DRY principles, strengthening system healthspan and maintainability.
justification_or_plan: 1. Extracted `mcpClient` creation block into `ensureMcpClient()` in `app/public/app.js`. 2. Extracted `registerTool` error handlers into `createErrorResponse()` in `app/server.js`. 3. Verified frontend and backend unit test suites continue to pass via `node --test`.
